appDescription.message: Unread mail from every inbox you're signed in to, in one fast panel. Read, archive or delete it without opening a tab.

opt_quietHint.message: An inbox without notifications still shows in the panel and the count, but makes no noise.

opt_primaryHint.message: Primary tab only reads a Gmail feed that Google does not document, so it can stop working.

opt_quietHoursText.message: No notifications or sound. The count keeps updating.

opt_quietWeekendText.message: The weekend days follow your region.

opt_never.message: Never notify when the sender or subject contains

opt_neverText.message: One word or address per line. The mail still shows in the panel, without a notification or sound.

opt_only.message: Notify only when the sender or subject contains

opt_onlyText.message: Leave it empty to hear about all mail.

opt_readOnOpen.message: Mark as read when opened in the panel

opt_readOnOpenText.message: Otherwise mail stays unread until you act on it.

opt_sync.message: Keep a copy in Chrome sync

opt_syncText.message: A computer signed in to the same Chrome profile offers to restore it.

opt_syncFailed.message: Chrome sync could not save the settings

opt_fileText.message: Save your settings to a file or load them from one.

opt_importConfirm.message: Replace your settings with the ones in this file?

opt_importBad.message: This is not a Mail Deck settings file

opt_restoreTitle.message: Your settings are in Chrome sync

opt_restoreText.message: Saved on $1. Use them on this computer?

opt_savedHint.message: Changes save as you make them.

opt_initialPeriod.message: First check after the browser starts

opt_networkWatch.message: Check when Gmail tabs or the network change

opt_networkWatchText.message: Catches mail you read in Gmail and reconnects after a dropped connection.

opt_idleWatch.message: Check when you come back to the computer

opt_alphabeticText.message: Otherwise they follow the order you signed in to them.

opt_forgetListText.message: Inboxes you signed out of disappear; the rest return on the next check.

opt_offHint.message: A switched-off inbox leaves the panel, the badge and notifications.

opt_labelsHint.message: Labels: watch these Gmail labels instead of the inbox, separated by commas, for example:

opt_servicesHint.message: Sign in on the service’s site as usual, then turn it on here. Mail Deck reads it with that session, the way it reads Gmail.

opt_servicesNote.message: These services have no public interface for this, so a change on their side can stop one until Mail Deck is updated.

opt_notification.message: Show a notification for new mail

opt_notificationText.message: A desktop pop-up with the sender and subject.

opt_buttonsText.message: The first two you pick fit.

opt_combined.message: Put several new emails in one notification

opt_threatAsNew.message: Notify about mail that arrived within

opt_threatAsNewText.message: Older unread mail stays quiet. Applies to sound too.

opt_formatText.message: Use [author_name], [author_email], [title], [summary] and [break] for a new line.

opt_truncate.message: Shorten the subject and text to

opt_silentTimeText.message: Right-click the toolbar icon, then Disable all notifications, then Custom.

opt_alert.message: Play a sound for new mail

opt_rulesText.message: A different sound when the sender, subject or text contains a word.

opt_minimalText.message: Shows >1K instead of the exact number.

opt_clickOne.message: Opens Gmail when there is one inbox

opt_smartOpen.message: When the icon opens Gmail, go to the newest unread email

opt_senderLogosText.message: Logos come from Google’s icon service, which sees only the sender’s domain.

opt_reuse.message: Switch to Gmail when it is already open

opt_everyWindow.message: Look for it in every window

opt_everyWindowText.message: Otherwise only in the current window.

opt_nextTo.message: Open next to the current tab

opt_inFront.message: Tell me when Gmail is already in front

opt_readOnArchive.message: Archiving also marks mail as read

opt_diagRow.message: Check how Mail Deck works with your inboxes

opt_diagText.message: Asks Gmail now, for every signed-in inbox. Nothing in your mail changes.

opt_noInboxes.message: Your inboxes show up here after the first check.

opt_diagOpenGmail.message: open Gmail once in this account

opt_diagNoMessage.message: the page has no message in it
